lines.text: GTA 6 launch day. Three questions, three answers.
One. Price. The standard edition is seventy-nine ninety-nine. Ultimate is ninety-nine ninety-nine.
Two. Is it on PC? No PC version has been announced. Right now it's PS5 and Xbox Series X and S.
Three. Size. Rockstar says up to 212 gigabytes.
Standard or Ultimate, which did you get? Follow for more GTA 6 answers.
